findings.passage: Second, we need to ban concealed carry and get guns out of our classrooms. However you feel about guns — whether you are the most ardent Second Amendment defender or you think all guns should be banned — we can all reasonably agree that guns have no place in our classrooms and on our campuses. As Regent, I'll advocate to exercise our authority under state and federal law to ban concealed carry on campus (open carry is already banned).
findings.note: Candidate voters-guide answer: says he will push to ban concealed carry on university campuses.

findings.passage: There is a legal precedent supporting banning guns in certain sensitive places, I will strongly push for a concealed carry ban.
findings.note: Same voters guide: cites legal precedent for banning guns in sensitive places and commits to pushing a concealed carry ban.

findings.passage: Nobody needs a gun to attend or teach a class. It’s incredibly dangerous and disruptive, and we need to make sure that we are passing common-sense gun-control measures across the board.
findings.note: Quoted by Westword at a candidate debate, backing the state's sensitive-spaces gun bill passed that spring and calling for gun-control measures broadly.
